title: Tenant Isolation: Enforce center boundaries on Classes, Puzzles, AI Scanner, and Assignments
assumptions: Cross-center resource access by ID returns 404 Not Found to prevent data enumeration.
List endpoints are strictly scoped to the caller's center_id unless caller is super_admin.
In Puzzle Bank, puzzles are visible to all teachers/admins in the same center; teachers only edit their own, while center_admins can edit/delete any puzzle in their center.
AI Scanner jobs and results are scoped strictly to the caller's center_id.
